request.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE newly composed 25:19 landscape card illustration, no text or frame. Card U11, the same bear's shadow repeats its previous strike after the real bear has already relaxed.
Reference image 1 is character identity ONLY. Reference images 2 U19 and 3 C09 provide mature bold graphic card-art styling ONLY. Do not copy their poses. Use broad closed flat color shapes, bold restrained dark contours, only 2–3 discrete tones per material. Absolutely no paint texture, grain, realistic fur strands, scattered facets, soft 3D lighting or gradients. Serious heavy wild presence, never cute or funny.
Camera sees one whole grey-purple wall from slightly behind the bear. A clear straight wall-floor seam near the lower fifth establishes that the shadow is projected on a flat wall. The REAL physical bear appears cropped at the RIGHT edge, occupying only the rightmost quarter. Include a small recognizable white-grey shoulder and partial side of the short thick muzzle, navy torso, and ONE relaxed forearm hanging LOWERED beside its body, elbow tucked back naturally, short cyan claws pointing down near its hip. Its physical attack is finished and it stands still; relaxed hand is low and CLOSED LOOSELY, never extended across the image.
On the LEFT two-thirds of the wall is ONE single continuous solid deep-navy silhouette of that SAME bear, with matching rounded ear, short muzzle, broad sloping shoulder/back, and ONE clearly raised forearm sweeping OUTWARD sideways. The raised striking arm of the shadow points away from the real bear. This is a sharply different pose from the lowered physical forearm. The shadow has no volume, no colored eye, no facial detail, no rim light, no internal shading, no opacity trails; it is visibly flat ink-like projected shadow integrated onto the wall and continuing toward the same source at the wall-floor seam. It is not a second creature or spectral companion.
A SINGLE short thin cyan arc tightly follows only the shadow claw edge, signaling the completed physical strike is now being repeated by its delayed shadow. No floating unattached arcs and no second strike silhouette.
Composition: small still vertical physical figure on right versus one large diagonally extended flat shadow on left. Broad quiet wall area around silhouettes. Palette limited to grey-purple wall, deep navy shadow, white-grey real shoulder, one tiny cyan shadow arc and tiny physical claw tips.
No extra arms, no multiple heads, no second bear, no transparent overlapping limbs, no text, symbols, numbers, borders or game UI. Silhouettes must make the time-displaced action legible at 125×95 thumbnail scale.

artist_observation: Physical forearm is lowered at right edge; flat shadow clearly strikes in different pose, with seam. Style is much flatter than R28. Review arc length and whether silhouette's backward sweep is clear.

plan_card.name: 暴风再临
image_review_watchpoints: 实体必须明显处于低收静止姿态，影子处于展开攻击姿态；若两者动作相同，将再次退化为普通投影或拖尾。
墙上影子需保留可与实体对应的熊头、背部、单前臂轮廓，并保持平面无体积；不能成为第二只实体熊或无归属幽灵伙伴。
影子仅有一次完整挥击轮廓和一小段爪侧青弧；不得增生多手、多头、透明叠肢。
右缘实体裁切必须足以指认影子的来源；实际图若只读成怪物影独立攻击而非同一动作回声，应重做构图。
plan_card.prompt:
卡片：U11《暴风再临》。创作一张新的独立插画，核心动词/关系为“再挥一次”。

镜头与抽象：侧后方看熊与一面完整暗墙。M1。
画面：画面右缘只露熊的白肩与已经自然收回、向下放松的前臂，实体动作明显结束。投在左侧墙面上的宽厚熊影却仍在向外挥击，一道短青弧只沿影子的爪侧出现。地面与墙的接缝清楚，影子是一整块平面，不是第二只实体熊。

大形与负形：右侧小实体的静止竖形，与左侧大影子的展开斜形形成可见动作差；只保留一个影子。
色彩：灰紫墙、深蓝平面影、灰白实体肩边、一段短青影弧。

25:19横向卡牌插画，只有画面，没有文字、标题、费用、边框或游戏UI。厚而克制的深色轮廓，硬边平涂，2—3个明暗层；少数完整大色块，背景服从唯一主读法。这是有意设计的图形概括，不用软质3D毛发、密集碎毛、体积光和粒子填充。实体角色出现时保持白灰宽肩、深蓝身体、短厚熊吻、青眼与青色短弯爪；只有场景确实露出胸部时才需要胸辫。纯环境或符号图不额外塞熊头、爪子或身份标记。用大形、留白、受力与尺度传达厚重和野性，不能把圆身摆拍、随机拉长的肢体或多余零件当作抽象。

参考用途：身份图用于确认实体角色；U19《风暴不散》用于主形清晰度、重量和气质；C09《雷霆横扫》用于色块简洁或对象关系。借用这些方法，不复制它们的角色占位、动作轴或独特构图。

明确避免：两个实体熊；两条悬空弧当作重演；相同姿势只做透明拖影；实体再次变成左侧巨大前爪；影子长出随机额外肢体。
图像语义：现实动作已收回，影子仍重复上一击；两者姿态不同但身份与动作来源可辨。
只表现上述单一场面，不增加说明文字、分镜、数值图标或与主动作无关的对象。
